credentials.title: Sign-in details
credentials.description: The email and password that open this panel. Your current password is needed to change either one.
credentials.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. To keep your password as it is, enter it again here.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Adds a code from your phone to every sign-in, so a stolen password isn't enough.
twoFactor.warning: Your account is protected by its password alone.

stepDescriptions.password: Confirm your password to link a new device to this account.
stepDescriptions.scan: Link an authenticator app to this account.
stepDescriptions.codes: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they won't be shown again.

twoFactor.recoverySaved: I've saved these codes somewhere safe
twoFactor.useAuthenticator: Use a code from your app instead
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code holding the setup key
twoFactor.disableDescription: Signing in will only need your password. Enter your password and a current code to confirm.

steps.install: Open an authenticator app on your phone, or install one.
steps.scan: Scan the QR code. If you can't, type the setup key instead.
steps.enter: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.

errors.recoveryCode: Enter a recovery code, like abcd-efgh-jkmn-pqrs.
